newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit in range after recovering on fund demand.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit in range after recovering on fund demand.

text.p: The ringgit was trading in a range after making a sudden, sharp recovery earlier on dollar selling by U.S. and Japanese funds, dealers said on Thursday.
They said selling emerged after dollar/ringgit failed to break through 2.50 a dollar.
"They were waiting for 2.50 to break. Once that did not happen, the funds sold dollars anyway," a dealer with a Malaysian bank said.
At 1000 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.4830/40 to a dollar.
The dealer said further gains could be limited if the dollar made fresh gains against other major currencies.
Dealers also said the ringgit had found fresh support in a thin London market.
They said demand for the dollars came from Kuala Lumpur around 2.4860, but that did not halt the ringgit's run.
One dealer said the market has been covering short dollar positions after the U.S. unit made record gains against the yen in the last few days.
"The market is still short dollars, but it is also bullish ringgit," he said.
